work_unit: Containerize the complete local LicenceIQ application stack

dispatch.scope: Independent Compose security and restart-path review
dispatch.outcome: review feedback integrated before final live validation

implementation.services: Compose starts Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL with pgvector, MinIO, and an idempotent MinIO bootstrap job.
implementation.persistence: Named PostgreSQL and MinIO volumes retain metadata, vectors, sessions, and original document bytes across container stops.
implementation.storage_security: The bootstrap account creates the private bucket and provisions a separate application account. The API account can access only documents/content objects in that bucket; MinIO root credentials never reach the API or frontend container.
implementation.runtime_safety: PostgreSQL migration runs before the document-free OpenAI preflight. The API does not accept uploads if the configured model is unavailable.
implementation.image_security: MinIO, Python, and Node images are pinned to immutable digests. Frontend and API run as the non-root licenceiq user. Docker build contexts exclude environment files and dependency caches.
implementation.operations: Use docker compose up -d --build --wait for initial or changed configuration. docker compose start is verified for unchanged stopped containers.

passed: docker compose config --quiet passed with both ignored environment files.
The backend image installed its locked Python dependencies and the frontend image completed the Next.js production build.
docker compose up -d --wait reported healthy PostgreSQL, MinIO, backend, and frontend services; the one-time bootstrap exited successfully.
The API health endpoint and frontend root both returned HTTP 200.
Alembic reported migration 20260920_0004 as the Docker database head.
A fictional licence PNG uploaded to Docker-backed MinIO, downloaded through the protected API with its temporary guest capability, and was deleted successfully.
A separate fictional licence completed the Docker OCR read path for one page and was deleted after verification.
docker compose stop followed by docker compose start restored the unchanged stack successfully.
Both application containers reported uid and gid 10001 instead of root.
git diff --check passed without whitespace errors.
notes: The first bootstrap attempt exposed Compose command-tokenization on a multiline shell command. It was replaced with a mounted, LF-enforced bootstrap script and retested.
Existing host frontend and API processes were verified by their LicenceIQ command paths before being stopped to free ports 3000 and 8000 for Docker.

Docker Desktop restarted its Windows engine connector during the image build. Stale Compose containers and the network were removed with down --remove-orphans, never with volume removal, before the final clean start and restart validation.
